title: Can You Rent a Boat Without a Skipper in Madeira?
description: Only with a valid licence. Portuguese law says whoever commands a recreational boat needs a licence, and EU licences count. Why most trips have a skipper.
heroAlt: A skipper at the helm seen from behind, steering a motor boat along Madeira's south coast cliffs
keywords: can you rent a boat without a skipper in madeira
do you need a licence to drive a boat in portugal
is an eu boat licence valid in portugal
